items.name: Algebra
items.description: Manipulating expressions, equations and functions; the backbone of every quantitative career.
levelDescriptors: Factorises and solves quadratics and simultaneous equations
Works fluently with functions, inequalities and sequences
Handles complex numbers, matrices and binomial expansions
Solves olympiad and JEE Advanced level algebra

items.name: Calculus
items.description: Limits, differentiation and integration used to model change in engineering, physics, economics and ML.
levelDescriptors: Understands rate of change and slope
Applies derivatives to optimisation and integrates by standard methods
Solves differential equations and area/volume problems
Handles multivariable and rigorous analysis problems

items.name: Statistics and Probability
items.description: Describing data, reasoning about uncertainty and drawing conclusions from samples.
levelDescriptors: Reads mean, median, mode and simple charts
Designs studies and interprets models critically

items.name: Geometry and Trigonometry
items.description: Shapes, angles, coordinates and vectors; the language of design and engineering drawings.
levelDescriptors: Uses Pythagoras, similarity and basic trigonometry
Works with coordinate geometry and circle theorems

items.name: Mechanics
items.description: Forces, motion, energy and rotation: the core of physics and every engineering branch.
levelDescriptors: Solves straight-line motion and force-diagram problems
Handles energy, momentum and circular motion
Solves rotational dynamics and multi-body problems
Models real systems with calculus-based mechanics

items.name: Electricity and Magnetism
items.description: Circuits, fields and electromagnetic induction behind electronics and power systems.
levelDescriptors: Applies Ohm's law and series/parallel rules
Works with electric fields, capacitance and magnetism
Solves induction and AC circuit problems
Uses Maxwell's equations qualitatively and quantitatively

items.name: Organic Chemistry
items.description: Structure and reactions of carbon compounds; essential for medicine, pharmacy and biotech.

items.name: Physical and Inorganic Chemistry
items.description: Mole concept, equilibrium, thermodynamics, kinetics and periodic trends.
levelDescriptors: Balances equations and uses the mole
Links quantum ideas to bonding and spectra

items.name: Human Physiology
items.description: How organ systems work together; the base of medicine, nursing and physiotherapy.
levelDescriptors: Links structure to function across systems
Explains homeostasis, hormones and nervous control

items.name: Genetics and Molecular Biology
items.description: Inheritance, DNA, gene expression and biotechnology tools.
levelDescriptors: Applies recombinant DNA and population genetics
Reads research on genomics and CRISPR critically

items.name: Accounting Principles
items.description: Recording transactions and preparing financial statements under Indian and international standards.
levelDescriptors: Understands debit, credit and the accounting equation
Prepares journals, ledgers and a trial balance
Handles partnership, company accounts and ratio analysis
Applies Ind AS / IFRS to complex cases

items.name: Microeconomics
items.description: Demand, supply, costs and market structures: how individuals and firms decide.
levelDescriptors: Draws demand and supply and finds equilibrium
Uses elasticity, cost curves and market structures
Analyses market failure and policy with diagrams
Uses game theory and mathematical models

items.name: Macroeconomics
items.description: National income, inflation, money, trade and government policy.
levelDescriptors: Explains the circular flow and money creation
Evaluates monetary, fiscal and trade policy
Builds and critiques macro models with data

items.name: Business Fundamentals
items.description: How organisations are structured, financed, marketed and managed.
levelDescriptors: Knows forms of business and functions
Analyses marketing mix and financial decisions

items.name: Polity and Governance
items.description: The Constitution, institutions and how public policy is made in India and abroad.
levelDescriptors: Explains fundamental rights and federal structure
Analyses elections, courts and policy processes

items.name: Historical Analysis
items.description: Reading sources, building arguments about cause and change over time.

items.name: Geography and Environment
items.description: Physical systems, resources, climate and human-environment interaction.
levelDescriptors: Analyses climate change and land use with data

items.name: Psychology Foundations
items.description: Theories of mind, behaviour, development and research methods.
levelDescriptors: Applies clinical frameworks to case studies

items.name: Legal Concepts
items.description: Contracts, torts, constitutional law and the logic of legal rules.
levelDescriptors: Knows what laws and courts do
Applies principles to fact patterns (CLAT legal reasoning)
Analyses case law and statutory interpretation
Builds full legal arguments with precedent

items.name: Literary and Textual Analysis
items.description: Close reading of texts, tone, argument and rhetoric.

items.name: Written Communication
items.description: Clear, structured writing for essays, reports, emails and briefs.
levelDescriptors: Organises a short essay with a clear point
Adapts tone and structure to audience

items.name: Spoken Communication
items.description: Speaking clearly and persuasively in class, interviews and meetings.
levelDescriptors: Explains an idea clearly to peers
Holds a structured discussion or viva

items.name: English Proficiency
items.description: Functional academic English; maps to IELTS bands for study abroad.

items.name: Presentation
items.description: Designing and delivering a clear, visual, timed presentation.
levelDescriptors: Uses visuals and story to hold attention
Presents to senior or external audiences with impact

items.name: Critical Thinking
items.description: Evaluating evidence and arguments, spotting assumptions and flaws.
levelDescriptors: Spots an obvious opinion vs fact
Synthesises conflicting evidence into sound judgements

items.name: Logical Reasoning
items.description: Deduction, puzzles and analytical reasoning tested in CLAT, IPMAT, LNAT and aptitude rounds.
levelDescriptors: Handles seating, ordering and coding puzzles

items.name: Quantitative Reasoning
items.description: Number sense, estimation and data interpretation under time pressure.
levelDescriptors: Solves timed aptitude and DI sets
Estimates and checks complex calculations fast
Top-percentile performance on CAT/IPMAT style quant

items.name: Structured Problem Solving
items.description: Breaking an unfamiliar problem into parts, trying approaches and checking results.
levelDescriptors: Chooses a method for a familiar problem
Breaks a new problem into steps
Scopes ambiguous problems and tests hypotheses
Solves open-ended problems others cannot frame

items.name: Research
items.description: Finding, evaluating, synthesising and citing sources.
levelDescriptors: Compares several sources and cites them
Writes a sourced synthesis on a question
Designs a small study and analyses results
Produces original research fit for publication

items.name: Data Literacy
items.description: Reading charts and spreadsheets and questioning numbers.
levelDescriptors: Reads a bar chart and table
Spots trends and simple errors in data
Summarises data with averages and charts
Cleans data and draws defensible conclusions
Leads data-driven decisions for a team

items.name: AI Tool Fluency
items.description: Using AI assistants productively and responsibly: prompting, checking output, citing use.
levelDescriptors: Writes clear prompts and checks answers
Uses AI to draft, code or study with verification
Builds repeatable AI workflows for real tasks

items.name: Financial Literacy
items.description: Budgeting, interest, investing and reading financial statements.
levelDescriptors: Plans a budget and compares loans
Values investments and builds financial plans

items.name: Visual and Creative Design
items.description: Composition, colour, typography and visual storytelling.
levelDescriptors: Develops a recognisable style across a portfolio

items.name: Entrepreneurial Thinking
items.description: Spotting opportunities, testing ideas cheaply and selling them.
levelDescriptors: Has ideas for products or services
Runs a small school project or stall
Validates an idea with real users or customers
Runs a venture with revenue or users
Builds and scales a team-led venture

items.name: Teamwork and Collaboration
items.description: Working in groups: sharing load, resolving conflict, delivering together.
levelDescriptors: Takes and completes a role in a team
Coordinates others and resolves minor conflict
Leads a team through a project

items.name: Leadership and Ownership
items.description: Taking initiative, setting direction and being accountable for outcomes.
levelDescriptors: Leads a club, event or team project
Leads people across functions with results

items.name: Empathy and User Understanding
items.description: Understanding what another person needs and feels; key to care, design and service roles.
levelDescriptors: Designs services or care around user needs

items.name: Ethical Reasoning
items.description: Weighing rights, duties and consequences in professional decisions.
levelDescriptors: Knows basic right and wrong in school rules
Explains an ethical dilemma from two sides

items.name: Time Management
items.description: Planning, prioritising and finishing work on time.
levelDescriptors: Uses a to-do list with reminders
Plans a week and meets most deadlines
Manages others' time and portfolios of work

items.name: Commercial Awareness
items.description: Understanding how businesses make money and what moves markets.
levelDescriptors: Knows big companies and what they sell
Explains revenue, cost and profit for a business
Follows business news and explains impacts
Analyses an industry and its competitors
Advises on strategy with market insight

items.name: Python Programming
items.description: Writing working programs in Python, the default language for data, AI and scripting.
levelDescriptors: Writes simple scripts with variables and loops
Designs large systems and reviews others' code

items.name: Data Structures and Algorithms
items.description: Choosing and implementing efficient data structures; the core of coding interviews.
levelDescriptors: Uses trees, graphs, hashing with complexity analysis

items.name: Web and App Development
items.description: Building websites and apps with HTML, CSS, JavaScript and a framework.
levelDescriptors: Builds an interactive site with JavaScript
Builds a full-stack app with a database
Ships production apps with auth, tests and deploys

items.name: SQL and Databases
items.description: Querying and modelling data in relational databases.
levelDescriptors: Filters, sorts and joins two tables
Writes aggregations, subqueries and window functions

items.name: Excel and Spreadsheets
items.description: Formulas, pivot tables and models in Excel or Google Sheets.
levelDescriptors: Uses lookups, pivot tables and conditional logic
Builds board-grade financial and operational models

items.name: Data Visualisation (Tableau / Power BI)
items.description: Turning data into clear charts and dashboards that drive decisions.
levelDescriptors: Chooses the right chart for a question
Designs dashboards used by managers weekly
Leads BI standards for an organisation

items.name: Machine Learning
items.description: Training and evaluating predictive models, from regression to neural networks.
levelDescriptors: Knows what a model and training data are
Trains a simple model with scikit-learn
Builds deep-learning models and deploys them
Researches or leads ML systems in production

items.name: Cybersecurity Fundamentals
items.description: Networks, threats, defence and ethical hacking.
levelDescriptors: Explains common attacks and networking basics
Configures firewalls and finds basic vulnerabilities
Performs penetration tests and incident response

items.name: CAD and Engineering Drawing
items.description: Drafting and 3D modelling in AutoCAD, SolidWorks or Fusion 360.
levelDescriptors: Runs simulations and produces manufacturing drawings
Leads design reviews for complex products

items.name: Electronics Prototyping
items.description: Building circuits with Arduino/Raspberry Pi and reading datasheets.
levelDescriptors: Lights an LED on a breadboard

items.name: Laboratory Techniques
items.description: Safe, precise practical work: titration, microscopy, PCR, measurement and error analysis.
levelDescriptors: Follows lab safety and simple procedures
Designs a fair test and analyses error

items.name: Financial Modelling and Valuation
items.description: Building three-statement models and valuing companies.
levelDescriptors: Values companies with DCF and comparables
Builds deal models for M&A and LBOs

items.name: Taxation and Audit
items.description: Indian direct and indirect tax (GST) and audit procedures.
levelDescriptors: Knows what income tax and GST are
Prepares GST returns and tax computations
Advises on complex tax and assurance

items.name: UX Research and Figma
items.description: User research, wireframing and prototyping in Figma.
levelDescriptors: Runs user tests and builds clickable prototypes
Designs complete flows with a design system
Leads product design and research practice

items.name: Drawing and Sketching
items.description: Freehand and perspective drawing for design and architecture entrance tests.
levelDescriptors: Renders light, texture and memory drawing

items.name: Game Engines (Unity / Unreal)
items.description: Building playable games with a game engine and C#/C++.
levelDescriptors: Builds a polished 3D game with physics
Ships a game on a store

items.name: Digital Marketing
items.description: SEO, social media, performance ads and analytics.
levelDescriptors: Plans posts for a brand page
Runs ad campaigns and reads analytics

items.name: Legal Research and Drafting
items.description: Finding case law and drafting notices, contracts and memos.
levelDescriptors: Knows what a judgment looks like

items.name: Debate and Advocacy
items.description: Building and delivering arguments under pressure; moots, MUNs and debates.
levelDescriptors: Competes in inter-school debates or MUN
Wins at state or national level; moots
Argues in court or international forums

items.name: Clinical Knowledge and Patient Care
items.description: Diagnosis, treatment and caring for patients safely.
levelDescriptors: Takes a history and vital signs (training)

items.name: Reporting and Storytelling
items.description: Finding stories, verifying facts and writing for print, video and digital.
levelDescriptors: Interviews and writes a news report
Leads investigations or an editorial desk

items.name: Policy Analysis
items.description: Analysing public problems, options and evidence to recommend policy.
levelDescriptors: Knows what a government scheme is
Summarises a policy and who it affects

items.name: Hospitality Operations
items.description: Front office, food and beverage, housekeeping and guest experience.
levelDescriptors: Handles guest check-in and service basics
Runs a shift in one department
Manages a department and its P&L

items.name: Pattern Making and Garment Construction
items.description: Turning a fashion sketch into a finished garment.
levelDescriptors: Develops a collection with tech packs

items.name: Actuarial and Risk Mathematics
items.description: Probability, financial maths and risk models used in insurance and pensions.
levelDescriptors: Knows what insurance and risk are
Calculates expected values and simple premiums
